title: Canonical internal-Hom comparison for derived direct image
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived direct image Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and derived internal Hom R\mathcal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the derived categories D(\mathcal O_X), D(\mathcal O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category]. For L,M\in D(\mathcal O_X), there is a canonical natural morphism $$Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(L,M)\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(Rf_*L,Rf_*M).$$ It is the internal-Hom projection comparison induced by the derived pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general] and evaluation; no isomorphism assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: Remark remark-projection-formula-for-internal-hom (used as the first arrow of duality.tex equation-sheafy-trace)

proof.text: Obtain the scheme pullback/direct-image adjunction a from nonempty_derivedPullbackAdjunction. Obtain canonical natural tensor-Hom equivalences ex and ey from exists_canonicalDerivedTensorHom; their inverses give adjunctions bX and bY via Mathlib Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. Both required naturality laws are proved from the three-variable naturality equation.

Obtain a canonical monoidal model m of derivedPullback f. Define t at (A,B) to be the inverse of m.μIso A B. Prove its product-category naturality by cancellation of the tensorator isomorphisms and the left and right tensorator naturality laws.

For L,M define c(L,M) by transposing the identity map of Rf_*RHom(L,M): apply the pullback adjunction inverse, ex, identity tensor the pullback counit after t, then transpose by a and ey. Naturality in the test map alpha proves the required mate equation. To prove naturality in L,M, apply ey injectivity to the naturality square and use ex and ey naturality, t naturality, and counit naturality. These computations are implemented in the private internalHomMate_of_tensorComparison helper. Unlike the private isomorphism-based helper of GlobalHomAdjunctionIso, it accepts an arbitrary natural tensor comparison, with no inverse or invertibility hypothesis; apply it to t.hom. Package a,bX,bY,t,c and rewrite the homEquiv of mkOfHomEquiv to get exactly the original target statement.

lean.statement: theorem exists_derivedDirectImage_internalHom_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] : ∃ (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (bX : ∀ L : schemeDerivedCategory X, tensorRight L ⊣ (Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj (op L)) (bY : ∀ L : schemeDerivedCategory Y, tensorRight L ⊣ (Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj (op L)) (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅ (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X)) (c : derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).op.prod (schemeDerivedDirectImage f) ⋙ derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf), ∀ (L M : schemeDerivedCategory X) (A : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (α : A ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op L, M))), ((bY ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L)).homEquiv A ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M)).symm (α ≫ c.app (op L, M)) = a.homEquiv (A ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L) M (t.hom.app (A, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L) ≫ (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj A) ⊗ₘ a.counit.app L) ≫ ((bX L).homEquiv ((derivedPullback f).obj A) M).symm ((a.homEquiv A ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op L, M))).symm α))
